accounting.currentRetainedStrings: Public ordered-set count before the private pass.
accounting.privateUniqueStringsAdded: Difference in the combined ordered-set count across the private pass; a duplicate is zero.
accounting.combinedRetainedStrings: Final public plus admitted private ordered-set count.
accounting.privateAcceptedValues: Number of eligible nonempty private values admitted; this may exceed unique additions.

privateEligibility: Use the actual dynamic Class from object_getClass for the exact NSCustomToolTipDrawView name check and the same Class for ivar lookup.
Require the observed view.window to equal the selected help-tag window; missing or mismatched identity is not replaced with an owner identity.
Require the view to be the selected contentView or its descendant and the selected window to be visible, nonminiaturized, alpha-positive and occlusion-visible.
Require the view not to be hidden through its ancestor chain, with finite nonempty bounds and visibleRect intersection.
Require a finite nonempty clipped rectangle converted into the selected window's coordinates.
Require an object-typed _attributedString ivar and a post-read repeat of the same window/subtree/visibility/geometry eligibility before admitting nonempty text.

boundaries.unknownData: Missing private diagnostics and failed/ineligible read values remain explicit unknowns; they are not empty successful reads.
boundaries.exceptionScope: Only the added private read/metadata path is guarded; original public exceptions are not swallowed.
boundaries.privateLayout: Host/version dependent, with no public API promise for this private class or ivar.
boundaries.temporalLimit: The two eligibility observations bracket the private read; they do not prove continuous visibility, rendering, or pixel content.
boundaries.durationLimit: Read-count limits are not a wall-time guarantee.

verifierCorrection.privacy: No raw tooltip strings, class names, arbitrary descriptions, paths, exception text, or added free-form payload fields are projected.
verifierCorrection.failureBehavior: Original JSON bytes, original native commands, timeouts, strict assertions, startup/watchdog reporters, and primary failure/cleanup behavior remain unchanged.
